verify_kinds.auto: Proven by automated tests the agent writes and runs
verify_kinds.agent-check: Agent produces the artifact (doc, measurement) and checks it against acceptance
verify_kinds.manual-win: Needs a real Windows run; agent may close it only with recorded evidence from Windows
verify_kinds.manual-mac: Needs physical Apple Silicon; agent sets needs_manual_check unless it ran there
verify_kinds.human: Owner task; agents never mark these done

features.title: Console flood cannot stall the main process
features.description: Found by the S05.3 spike: Electron emits a main-process event per console message, so a page logging ~100k messages/s stalls the browser UI thread for seconds even with the listener-detaching flood guard. Needs a decision record.

features.title: Close and quit never drop unsaved edits
features.description: Added after the S03 security review: closing the window or quitting dropped unsaved edits silently. Electron ignores beforeunload return values, so main intercepts the window 'close' event and asks the workbench over the typed IPC.
acceptance: Closing the window or quitting the app with unsaved edits first saves them; the window closes / the app quits only after the writes are confirmed
If a save fails, the window stays open with the save-failure state (reason, retry, save elsewhere) and the edits stay in the editor
A crashed or unresponsive workbench cannot block closing forever (bounded wait)
Covered by e2e (window close success and failure, app quit) and unit tests of the close guard
